summary: Coherus Oncology, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a sales agreement with Leerink Partners LLC for an at-the-market offering of up to $50.0 million of common stock. The company may sell shares from time to time, with Leerink acting as agent under a shelf registration statement. Leerink receives up to a 3.0% commission and indemnification rights. This is a routine equity distribution facility, not a special situation. No special-situation elements such as acquisition, tender, or restructuring are present. Watch for future takedowns and dilution, but no risk-arb angle exists.
